object_description: compact elongated volume with articulated cuts and terraces
design_condition: The volume aligns with the existing administration building, expanding the street into a tree-separated forecourt while creating a coherent sequence of green outdoor spaces and a widening gap that protects adjacent school and kindergarten spaces.

positive.statement: The placement creates a noticeable anteroom and a coherent sequence of attractive outdoor spaces.
The compact volume and minimal east-west extent create useful distance and protected outdoor spaces.
The volume is shaped by incisions and expansions that articulate entrances, covered play areas, and terraces.
The generous skylight supports daylight, clear orientation, and differentiated circulation.
The proposal is extremely convincing in its compactness and offers a coherent architectural concept.
The structural concept promises cost-effective production and the construction approach supports robustness and low maintenance.

negative.statement: Conflicts between pedestrians and vehicles are expected at the access to the new building.
The use of the building is not sufficiently noticeable in its expression.
The effect of the materials on the attractiveness of the spaces for children is questioned.
Reducing the number of outdoor parking spaces could clarify and separate pedestrian and vehicle access.
It must be carefully examined how the fire-protection requirements can be fully met.
